foundation: Barrot V3 execution, verification, security and preservation

material_corrections.prior_error: A prior graph addendum recorded CIRCLE-to-RIPPLE as NO_DIRECT_PARTNERSHIP_ESTABLISHED.
material_corrections.corrected_fact: Ripple and Circle directly announced a product integration partnership on 2025-06-12 to bring native USDC to XRPL. Circle Mint and APIs support USDC on XRPL. Ripple said it intended to use USDC alongside RLUSD in Ripple Payments.
limits: No equity, merger, joint ownership or exclusive alliance established.
Native USDC on XRPL does not imply every payment uses XRP as a bridge.

material_corrections.prior_risk: Coinbase Global Derivatives product names can cause non-US Coinbase Advanced cross-collateral terms to be incorrectly applied to US institutional Coinbase Prime accounts.
material_corrections.corrected_fact: Separate three product regimes: (1) Coinbase Advanced Global Derivatives in supported non-US regions lists XRP cross-collateral at 15% X:SM haircut and a dash in X:PM; (2) Coinbase Prime Global Derivatives for eligible US institutions publicly lists USDC/BTC/ETH, not XRP, and cross-collateral is not enabled in the Prime portfolio; (3) US Derivatives use USD cash, with USDC only indirectly through optional auto-conversion.
limits: No XRP collateral balances or customer counts are disclosed.
A dash in the X:PM haircut column is not silently converted to zero.

material_corrections.corrected_fact: The March 2026 SEC/CFTC digital-commodity interpretation referenced by CFTC Letter 26-17 lists XRP as an example. Letter 26-17 provides conditional staff no-action relief for customer-owned digital commodities and payment stablecoins transferred by CFM to its affiliated foreign broker for specified 30.7 customer foreign futures/options positions at Deribit, under right-of-reuse and enumerated safeguards.
clarifications: The 120% cap is the Regulation 30.7(c) limit on 30.7 Customer Funds deposited with CBBM, not a standalone numbered condition created by Letter 26-17.

The letter records CFM's factual-background representation that Deribit would maintain assets equal to 100% of relevant net liquidating equity at Coinbase Custody Trust; this is not one of the numbered no-action conditions and not an independent custody audit.
The letter's staff positions are not binding on the Commission.
Coinbase Prime's current public US collateral list still excludes XRP.

material_corrections.corrected_fact: Circle's Arc launch release reported 98.8% of global agent-driven transaction volume in USDC; the Agent Stack page separately reports 99.8% of x402 transaction value; agents.circle.com separately displayed 99.6% of agent transaction volume on x402 for October 2026.
limits: Different metric definitions and observation windows; not Arc-specific; do not average or treat as a single time series without denominator and window reconciliation.

circle_arc_metric_quality.reason: Different denominators and windows; all are company-reported; the 98.8% figure is not Arc-chain-specific.

capital_and_collateral_policy.distinction: Collateral eligibility or use is not equivalent to a spot purchase or net new capital inflow.
capital_and_collateral_policy.xrp_rebalancing_hypothesis: If XRP is positive equity in a non-US cross-collateral account and another settlement currency becomes negative, the documented rebalancing mechanism could sell/use XRP to buy the deficit currency. This is a conditional mechanism inference; no XRP-specific rebalancing volume is disclosed.
